title: SurgVIL: Scaling Surgical Robot Imitation Learning with Open-source Surgical Videos
summary: Learning-based surgical robot autonomy requires large-scale demonstrations with synchronized videos and robot actions, but such data are exceedingly rare in clinical or realistic tissue settings because robot kinematics are typically inaccessible outside controlled research systems. In contrast, phantom data collected on research platforms provide accurate action labels but lack the visual diversity of real tissue. We propose SurgVIL, a framework for scaling surgical robot imitation learning using open-source surgical videos. SurgVIL combines kinematically labeled phantom robot demonstrations with surgical videos from open-source datasets and online sources for policy learning. Since these videos lack robot motion labels, we estimate approximate kinematics as weak supervision. We evaluate SurgVIL on two da Vinci robot tasks: needle pick-up and cholecystectomy cutting. Across ACT, $π_0$, and GR00T-H backbones, adding surgical videos substantially improves generalization to real-tissue and out-of-distribution settings, suggesting a scalable path from phantom training toward generalizable surgical robot policies.
tldr: SurgVIL proposes a framework that combines phantom robot demonstrations with open-source surgical videos (via weak supervision) to scale imitation learning for surgical robots, improving generalization to real-tissue settings.
tldr_zh: SurgVIL 提出了一个框架，将幻影机器人演示与开源手术视频（通过弱监督）相结合，以扩展手术机器人的模仿学习，提高在真实组织环境中的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 基于学习的手术机器人自主性需要大规模同步视频与机器人动作的演示数据，但在临床或 realistic 组织环境中此类数据极为稀少，因为机器人运动学通常只能在受控研究系统外获取。相比之下，在研究平台上收集的仿体数据提供了精确的动作标签，但缺乏真实组织的视觉多样性。我们提出 SurgVIL，一个利用开源手术视频扩展手术机器人模仿学习的框架。SurgVIL 将带有运动学标签的仿体机器人演示与来自开源数据集和在线资源的手术视频相结合，用于策略学习。由于这些视频缺乏机器人运动标签，我们估计近似运动学作为弱监督。我们在两个达芬奇机器人任务上评估 SurgVIL：拾针和胆囊切除术切割。在 ACT、π₀ 和 GR00T-H 骨干网络上，加入手术视频显著提高了对真实组织和分布外场景的泛化能力，这表明了一条从仿体训练向可泛化手术机器人策略的可扩展路径。

title: Beyond Uncertainty: Generalizable Failure Monitoring for Surgical Segmentation under Acquisition Degradation
summary: Surgical segmentation networks can fail silently under acquisition degradation: predicted masks may be wrong even when model confidence remains high. Existing deployment-time monitors rely primarily on uncertainty estimates and can therefore miss confident failures. We present TCSR-Monitor (Temporal Conformal Surgical Risk Monitor), a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework that combines confidence with observable shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues. TCSR-Monitor wraps a frozen segmentation model, requires no model internals, and operates without ground truth at deployment. We also introduce a validation protocol to assess whether alarms remain credible under distribution shift. On EndoVis 2017, leave-one-corruption-out evaluation shows that TCSR-Monitor generalizes to unseen acquisition degradations and substantially outperforms confidence-based baselines. A circularity control confirms that it predicts segmentation failure rather than simply detecting corrupted images. Mondrian conformal calibration balances miss-rates across degradation severities, but a single global threshold still produces false alarms on up to 40% of correctly segmented frames at moderate corruption. Zero-shot transfer to SAM2 demonstrates feature portability, although entropy outperforms the transferred monitor at both evaluated thresholds. Overall, reliable monitoring under acquisition degradation benefits from complementary observable signals beyond confidence alone, but substantial false-alarm and transfer limitations remain.
tldr: TCSR-Monitor is a post-hoc failure-monitoring framework for surgical segmentation that combines confidence with shape, temporal-consistency, and image-quality cues, outperforming confidence-only baselines on corrupted data but still suffering from false alarms and limited transferability.
tldr_zh: TCSR-Monitor 是一种用于手术分割的部署后故障监控框架，它结合了置信度与形状、时序一致性和图像质量线索，在受损数据上优于仅基于置信度的基线方法，但仍存在误报和迁移性有限的问题。
summary_zh: 外科分割网络可能在采集退化情况下静默失败：即使模型置信度仍然较高，预测掩膜也可能出错。现有的部署时监控主要依赖不确定性估计，因此可能遗漏高置信度下的失败案例。我们提出TCSR-Monitor（时间一致性外科风险监控器），这是一种后置失败监控框架，将置信度与可观测的形状、时间一致性及图像质量线索相结合。TCSR-Monitor封装了冻结的分割模型，无需访问模型内部结构，且部署时无需真实标签。我们还引入了一种验证协议，用于评估在分布偏移下警报是否保持可信。在EndoVis 2017数据集上，留一退化评估表明，TCSR-Monitor能够泛化至未见过的采集退化情况，并显著优于基于置信度的基线方法。循环性控制实验证实，该框架预测的是分割失败，而非简单地检测退化图像。Mondrian共形校准平衡了不同退化严重程度下的漏报率，但在中等退化下，单一全局阈值仍会在多达40%的正确分割帧上产生误报。零样本迁移至SAM2显示了特征的便携性，尽管在两个评估阈值下，熵的表现均优于迁移后的监控器。总体而言，在采集退化条件下实现可靠监控需借助置信度以外的互补可观测信号，但依然存在显著的误报和迁移局限性。

title: GeoPose: Patient-agnostic CTA-to-DSA registration through projection-space calibration
summary: Aligning intraoperative biplanar digital subtraction angiography (DSA) to pre-procedural computed tomography angiography (CTA) requires rapid and accurate 3D-to-2D registration. Optimization-based methods are sensitive to initialization and may require hundreds of iterations, whereas learning-based approaches commonly rely on patient-specific training. We propose GeoPose, a population-trained framework that estimates the C-arm pose in a learned canonical frame and transfers it to the native frame of an unseen CTA through projection-space calibration and transform composition. A population-trained residual network refines the pose, followed optionally by low-budget image-driven optimization. GeoPose requires neither patient-specific adaptation nor explicit inter-volume preregistration. On 80 DSA observations from 20 held-out patients, optimization-free GeoPose achieved a carotid mean projected centerline distance (mPCD) of 5.8 mm and a clDice of 0.45, compared with 14.5 mm and 0.28 for the best-performing baseline, while requiring only 0.15 s. After 25 optimization iterations, GeoPose reached an mPCD of 4.6 mm and a clDice of 0.58 in approximately two seconds. Under the same budget, native-initialized optimization achieved 14.6 mm and 0.15, respectively. GeoPose thus provides rapid native-frame registration with fixed population-level weights and the geometric correspondence required for downstream biplanar 3D vascular reconstruction.
tldr: GeoPose proposes a population-trained, patient-agnostic framework for fast 3D-to-2D registration of CTA to intraoperative DSA using projection-space calibration and a residual network, achieving superior accuracy and speed without patient-specific training.
tldr_zh: GeoPose提出了一种基于群体训练、患者无关的框架，通过投影空间校准和残差网络，实现CTA与术中DSA的快速3D-to-2D配准，无需患者特定训练，在精度和速度上均优于基线方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
将术中双平面数字减影血管造影（DSA）与术前计算机断层血管造影（CTA）对齐需要快速且精确的3D到2D配准。基于优化的方法对初始化敏感，且可能需要数百次迭代，而基于学习的方法通常依赖于患者特定的训练。我们提出GeoPose，一种群体训练的框架，能在学习到的规范坐标系中估计C臂位姿，并通过投影空间校准与变换组合，将其传递至未见过的CTA的原生坐标系。群体训练的残差网络对位姿进行精化，随后可选用低开销的图像驱动优化。GeoPose既不需要患者特定的适应，也不需要显式的体积间预配准。在来自20个保留患者的80个DSA观测中，无优化的GeoPose实现了颈动脉平均投影中心线距离（mPCD）为5.8 mm，clDice为0.45，而最佳基线方法分别为14.5 mm和0.28，且仅需0.15秒。经过25次优化迭代后，GeoPose在大约两秒内达到mPCD 4.6 mm和clDice 0.58。在相同预算下，原生初始化优化分别达到14.6 mm和0.15。因此，GeoPose以固定的群体级权重和下游双平面3D血管重建所需的几何对应关系，实现了快速的原生坐标系配准。

title: Sterilizable Scene Graph Generation for Operating Rooms
summary: Scene graph generation from surgical video enables a holistic and structured understanding of surgical scenes by modeling objects and their semantic relationships. Despite recent advances, state-of-the-art approaches rely on large, parameter-heavy deep learning models that are impractical for deployment in the operating room (OR) due to hardware footprint, hygiene constraints, latency, and data privacy concerns. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first scene graph generation method built on NCAs and the first NCA framework capable of learning structured representations. We introduce SG-NCA, a lightweight scene graph generation framework based on Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), designed for inference in fanless devices critical for OR hygiene protocols. SG-NCA is the first scene graph generation combining NCA-based multiclass segmentation for efficient object detection and feature extraction with a lightweight relation predictor. We evaluate SG-NCA on videos of cataract surgery and cholecystectomy, demonstrating performance comparable to established baselines while requiring 55x fewer parameters. We showcase deployment on fanless edge devices better suited for the OR and demonstrate downstream applications such as surgical video captioning, highlighting SG-NCA's potential for affordable, privacy-preserving, and OR-ready intraoperative scene understanding.
tldr: SG-NCA is a lightweight scene graph generation framework for operating rooms using Neural Cellular Automata, achieving comparable performance to baselines with 55x fewer parameters and enabling deployment on fanless edge devices for privacy-preserving intraoperative understanding.
tldr_zh: SG-NCA是一种基于神经细胞自动机的轻量级手术室场景图生成框架，以参数减少55倍的性能达到与基线相当的水平，并支持在无风扇边缘设备上部署，实现隐私保护的术中理解。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
从手术视频中生成场景图，通过建模对象及其语义关系，能够实现对手术场景的整体化、结构化理解。尽管近期取得了进展，但现有最先进方法依赖于参数量庞大的深度学习模型，由于硬件占用、卫生约束、延迟以及数据隐私等问题，难以在实际手术室中部署。据我们所知，这是首个基于神经细胞自动机（NCA）的场景图生成方法，也是首个能够学习结构化表征的NCA框架。我们提出了SG-NCA——一种基于神经细胞自动机的轻量级场景图生成框架，专为满足手术室卫生规范至关重要的无风扇设备上的推理而设计。SG-NCA是首个将基于NCA的多类分割（用于高效目标检测与特征提取）与轻量级关系预测器相结合的场景图生成方法。我们在白内障手术和胆囊切除术视频上评估了SG-NCA，其性能与现有基线方法相当，而参数量减少了55倍。我们展示了在更适合手术室的无风扇边缘设备上的部署，并演示了下游应用（如手术视频字幕生成），突显了SG-NCA在实现经济、隐私保护且适用于手术室的术中场景理解方面的潜力。

title: US-VLA: An Ultrasound Vision-Language-Action Model for Embodied Abdomina
summary: Artificial intelligence-assisted ultrasound scanning enhances diagnostic reliability and efficiency by providing real-time guidance for standardized image acquisition and reducing operator dependence. However, existing reinforcement learning and learning-assisted ultrasound scanning methods typically rely on carefully designed reward functions or extensive interaction data, which limits their generalization ability and stability across different devices, patient populations, and complex clinical scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose an ultrasound vision-language-action model (US-VLA) for automated ultrasound scanning that explicitly encodes clinical semantic goals and generates sequential probe manipulation actions under real-time ultrasound feedback. In particular, we first design an ultrasound-aware expert fusion module to jointly integrate ultrasound observations with auxiliary contextual information, enabling semantic ultrasound feedback to effectively guide the scanning process. Then, we construct US-VLA-Data, a real-world dataset covering liver and kidney examinations, which includes five clinically defined standard planes and comprises 320 expert scanning trajectories with approximately 80,000 synchronized timesteps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that US-VLA achieves competitive performance in ultrasound probe manipulation tasks, indicating its effectiveness and promising generalization within the evaluated abdominal ultrasound setting. The source code is available at https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA.
tldr: Proposes US-VLA, an ultrasound vision-language-action model that integrates clinical semantic goals with real-time ultrasound feedback to generate probe manipulation actions for automated abdominal scanning, validated on a new dataset of 320 expert trajectories.
tldr_zh: 提出US-VLA，一种超声视觉-语言-动作模型，将临床语义目标与实时超声反馈相结合，生成探头操作动作以自动进行腹部扫描，并在包含320条专家轨迹的新数据集上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 人工智能辅助超声扫描通过为标准化图像采集提供实时指导并减少操作者依赖性，从而增强了诊断的可靠性和效率。然而，现有的强化学习及学习辅助超声扫描方法通常依赖于精心设计的奖励函数或大量的交互数据，这限制了其在不同设备、患者群体以及复杂临床场景中的泛化能力和稳定性。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种用于自动化超声扫描的超声视觉-语言-动作模型（US-VLA），该模型显式编码临床语义目标，并在实时超声反馈下生成序列化的探头操作动作。具体而言，我们首先设计了一个超声感知专家融合模块，用于联合整合超声观测与辅助上下文信息，从而使语义超声反馈能够有效引导扫描过程。随后，我们构建了US-VLA-Data，一个涵盖肝脏和肾脏检查的真实世界数据集，该数据集包含五种临床定义的标准平面，并由320条专家扫描轨迹组成，总计约80,000个同步时间步。大量实验表明，US-VLA在超声探头操作任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能，证明了其在所评估的腹部超声场景中的有效性和良好的泛化能力。源代码可在 https://github.com/VMVLab/US-VLA 获取。

title: FlexWorm: Primitive-augmented Hybrid Contact-motion Planning for Suction-based Multi-segment Deformable Robots
summary: Multi-segment suction-based soft robots are promising for inspection and maintenance in confined or fragile environments, but existing approaches still depend heavily on manually designed gaits and environment-specific motion scripts. This work presents a planning framework for serial multi-segment soft robots with deformable body segments and boundary suction pads. The formulation targets full 3D navigation on complex surfaces and explicitly handles discrete adhesion switching and continuous body deformation under geometric, collision, and quasi-static feasibility constraints, while remaining agnostic to the specific actuation realization used to produce segment deformation. Its core, block-wise IK hybrid search (IKHS), performs best-first search over feasible adhesion transitions while solving inverse kinematics only on induced free blocks. On top of IKHS, primitive-augmented hybrid search (PaHS) uses a learned observation--primitive embedding to retrieve short validated motion segments for fast local proposal, with fallback to standard IKHS branching when retrieval fails. In simulation, the framework consistently outperforms controlled baselines in planning success, transition quality, and efficiency across diverse terrains. PaHS matches IKHS in success rate while substantially reducing planning time. Repeated hardware experiments on a pneumatic multi-segment soft robot further demonstrate executability and online recovery under actuation and adhesion uncertainty.
tldr: A planning framework for multi-segment suction-based soft robots that combines block-wise inverse kinematics search with a learned primitive-augmented hybrid search to navigate complex surfaces, outperforming baselines in simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: 一种用于多段吸盘式软体机器人的规划框架，结合了块状逆运动学搜索和学习到的原始增强混合搜索，以在复杂表面上导航，在仿真和硬件上均优于基线。
summary_zh: 基于多段吸盘的软体机器人在受限或脆弱环境中的检测与维护领域具有应用前景，但现有方法仍高度依赖人工设计的步态及特定环境的运动脚本。本文提出一种面向串联多段软体机器人的规划框架，该机器人具有可变形躯干段和边界吸盘。该框架针对复杂曲面上的完整三维导航场景，在几何约束、碰撞约束及准静态可行性约束下，显式处理离散粘附切换与连续体变形问题，同时与实现段变形的具体驱动方式无关。其核心模块为分块逆运动学混合搜索（IKHS），该方法在可行粘附状态转换上执行最佳优先搜索，同时仅对诱导的自由分块求解逆运动学。在IKHS基础上，原语增强混合搜索（PaHS）利用学习得到的观测-原语嵌入来检索经过验证的短运动片段以实现快速局部提议，当检索失败时则回退至标准IKHS分支。仿真结果表明，该框架在多种地形上的规划成功率、过渡质量及效率方面始终优于控制基线。PaHS在保持与IKHS相当成功率的同时，大幅缩短了规划时间。在气动多段软体机器人上重复进行的硬件实验进一步验证了其可执行性以及在驱动与粘附不确定性下的在线恢复能力。

title: The Right Prior for the Right Deformation: Rethinking Continuous Deformable Image Registration
summary: Deformable image registration models implicitly encode deformation priors through their parametrization and optimization. In this work, we conduct a validation study on continuous registration methods to examine how these implicit priors affect performance across different registration tasks. Classic B-Spline transformations impose locality, smoothness, and scale through their control-point structure, whereas recent INR-based methods impose different priors through neural parameterization and optimization. We compare INR-Dense (IDIR), which directly models a dense displacement field using a SIREN-based INR; INR-BSCP (SINR), which predicts B-Spline control points with an INR; D-BSCP, which directly optimizes single-scale B-Spline control points; and MR-D-BSCP, which adds a multiresolution coarse-to-fine scheme. Experiments on inter-subject brain MR registration (OASIS) and intra-subject exhale-to-inhale lung CT registration (DIR-LAB 4DCT) reveal different behavior across deformation regimes. On OASIS, where deformations are moderate but locally complex, D-BSCP matches or slightly outperforms INR-BSCP, suggesting that the B-Spline parameterization accounts for much of INR-BSCP's effectiveness. On DIR-LAB 4DCT, where respiratory motion is larger and more coherent, single-scale B-Spline methods (D-BSCP and INR-BSCP) are less suitable, while INR-Dense and MR-D-BSCP are more effective. Across both tasks, MR-D-BSCP achieves the best performance among the tested continuous parameterizations. These findings highlight that registration accuracy depends strongly on matching the induced deformation prior to the target motion pattern, and support prior-deformation matching as a practical design principle for medical image registration. Our code will be available at https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR.
tldr: This paper compares continuous deformable image registration methods (B-Spline, INR) across brain and lung datasets, finding that matching deformation priors to target motion patterns is crucial for accuracy and that multi-resolution B-Spline (MR-D-BSCP) performs best overall.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了连续形变图像配准方法（B样条、INR）在脑部和肺部数据集上的表现，发现匹配形变先验与目标运动模式对准确性至关重要，多分辨率B样条（MR-D-BSCP）的整体性能最佳。
summary_zh: 可变形图像配准模型通过其参数化和优化隐式地编码了变形先验。在本工作中，我们对连续配准方法进行了一项验证研究，以考察这些隐式先验如何影响不同配准任务的性能。经典的B样条变换通过其控制点结构施加了局部性、平滑性和尺度，而近期基于INR的方法则通过神经参数化和优化施加了不同的先验。我们比较了：INR-Dense（IDIR），它使用基于SIREN的INR直接建模稠密位移场；INR-BSCP（SINR），它通过INR预测B样条控制点；D-BSCP，直接优化单尺度B样条控制点；以及MR-D-BSCP，它增加了多分辨率从粗到细的方案。在受试者间脑部MR配准（OASIS）和受试者内呼气到吸气肺部CT配准（DIR-LAB 4DCT）上的实验揭示了不同变形模式下的不同行为。在OASIS中，变形适中但局部复杂，D-BSCP与INR-BSCP相当或略优，表明B样条参数化在很大程度上解释了INR-BSCP的有效性。在DIR-LAB 4DCT中，呼吸运动更大且更连贯，单尺度B样条方法（D-BSCP和INR-BSCP）不太适用，而INR-Dense和MR-D-BSCP更有效。在两个任务中，MR-D-BSCP在测试的连续参数化方法中取得了最佳性能。这些发现强调，配准精度高度依赖于将诱导的变形先验与目标运动模式相匹配，并支持先验-变形匹配作为医学图像配准的实用设计原则。我们的代码将在 https://github.com/HengjieLiu/RightPriorDIR 提供。

title: What Matters is the Prompt: Prompt Sensitivity and Prompt Generation in Foundation Models for Lung Nodule Segmentation
summary: Lung nodule segmentation in computed tomography is essential for extracting clinically relevant information for lung cancer assessment and treatment planning. Foundation models have shown notable segmentation capabilities, but state-of-the-art approaches often depend on input prompts, such as points or boxes, making their performance sensitive to prompt quality and placement. Understanding the limitations and constraints of prompt-based foundation models is therefore essential for designing reliable medical image segmentation solutions. In this work, we investigate how prompt quality affects foundation models performance for lung nodule segmentation. We further propose a synthetic prompt-generation model to test if the dependence on manually provided prompts can be mitigated by generating synthetic prompts that can also improve segmentation performance. Perturbation experiments show that bounding box prompts generally outperform point prompts, while latest specialized medical imaging models achieve better performance than general purpose ones. The proposed approach obtains a Dice coefficient of 0.85, suggesting that synthetic prompt generation as a promising strategy for lung nodule segmentation with foundation models.
tldr: This paper investigates how prompt quality affects foundation model performance for lung nodule segmentation and proposes a synthetic prompt generation model to mitigate reliance on manual prompts, achieving a Dice coefficient of 0.85.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了提示质量如何影响肺结节分割中基础模型的性能，并提出了一种合成提示生成模型以减少对人工提示的依赖，达到了0.85的Dice系数。
summary_zh: 计算机断层扫描中的肺结节分割对于提取肺癌评估和治疗规划中的临床相关信息至关重要。基础模型已展现出显著的分割能力，但现有先进方法通常依赖于点或框等输入提示，使其性能对提示质量和位置敏感。因此，理解基于提示的基础模型的局限性和约束条件对于设计可靠的医学图像分割解决方案至关重要。本研究探究了提示质量如何影响基础模型在肺结节分割中的性能，并提出了一种合成提示生成模型，以检验通过生成合成提示是否能够减少对人工提供提示的依赖，同时提升分割性能。扰动实验显示，边界框提示通常优于点提示，而最新的专用医学成像模型比通用模型表现更佳。所提出的方法获得了0.85的Dice系数，表明合成提示生成作为借助基础模型进行肺结节分割的一种有前景的策略。

title: Design Optimization for Large High-Force Soft Robot Manipulators Under Gravitational Loads
summary: Designing large soft robots capable of generating high forces for physical human-robot interaction remains a significant challenge in soft robotics. Prior work in large soft robots has focused on proof-of-concept prototypes, and no systematic framework exists for determining the suitability of a design paradigm for a desired task. This manuscript introduces a method for optimizing the geometry of a soft robot limb, maximizing its blocking force subject to an anti-bucking constraint under its own gravitational loading. We demonstrate that an explicit solution exists to the proposed optimization problem under certain assumptions. Experiments with three geometries of a large, soft, pneumatically-actuated manipulator demonstrate that the method correctly predicts which designs meet constraints and which produces the largest end-effector forces. This method, with its closed-form solution, can allow designers to determine a-priori if an intended class of soft manipulators is an appropriate choice for physical interaction at large size scales.
tldr: This paper presents a method for optimizing the geometry of large soft robot limbs to maximize blocking force under gravitational loads while avoiding buckling, with a closed-form solution demonstrated experimentally.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种优化大型软体机器人肢体几何形状的方法，在避免屈曲的同时最大化阻挡力，并给出了闭式解，通过实验验证。
summary_zh: 设计能够产生高作用力以进行物理人机交互的大型软体机器人，仍是软体机器人领域的一项重大挑战。此前针对大型软体机器人的研究主要集中于概念验证原型，尚缺乏系统性框架来判断某一设计范式是否适配特定任务需求。本文提出一种软体机器人肢体几何优化方法，在自重载荷下的抗屈曲约束条件下最大化其堵转力。我们证明，在特定假设条件下，所提出的优化问题存在显式解。通过对三种几何构型的大型软体气动机械臂进行实验，验证了该方法能准确预测哪些设计满足约束条件，以及哪种设计能产生最大的末端执行器力。凭借其封闭解形式，该方法可使设计者预先判断目标类型的软体机械臂是否适用于大尺度下的物理交互场景。

title: TR-GS: High-Fidelity Sparse-View CT Volumetric Rendering via t-Distribution Gaussian Splatting and Ray-Confidence Modeling
summary: High-fidelity 3D medical visualization supports applications such as clinical assessment and surgical planning. Sparse-view computed tomography (CT) can reduce projection requirements and associated radiation exposure, but limited observations may introduce structural artifacts and reconstruction uncertainty. Although 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides an efficient explicit representation for volumetric rendering, existing CT methods based on standard Gaussian primitives may be sensitive to unreliable observations under sparse-view acquisition. We present TR-GS, a Gaussian-splatting framework for sparse view CT volumetric rendering. TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with projectable Student's t-distribution primitives and introduces a ray-confidence model that regulates their degrees of freedom according to local ray observability. Confidence-guided 3D wavelet regularization is further used to balance high-frequency detail preservation and noise suppression. This work is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that TR-GS improves over representative baselines in most evaluated settings and remains competitive in the remaining cases. The resulting volumetric representations may support downstream medical multimedia applications, including XR-based visualization and interactive clinical rendering.
tldr: TR-GS replaces standard Gaussian primitives with Student's t-distribution and introduces a ray-confidence model to improve sparse-view CT volumetric rendering, achieving high-fidelity results with reduced artifacts.
tldr_zh: TR-GS 用学生 t 分布基元替代标准高斯基元，并引入射线置信度模型，以改进稀疏视角 CT 体积渲染，在减少伪影的同时实现高保真结果。
summary_zh: 高保真三维医学可视化支持临床评估和手术规划等应用。稀疏视角计算机断层扫描（CT）可减少投影需求及相应的辐射暴露，但有限的观测数据可能引入结构伪影和重建不确定性。尽管三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）为体渲染提供了高效的显式表示，但基于标准高斯基元的现有CT方法在稀疏视角采集条件下可能对不可靠观测敏感。我们提出TR-GS——一种面向稀疏视角CT体渲染的高斯泼溅框架。TR-GS用可投影的学生t分布基元替代标准高斯基元，并引入射线置信度模型，根据局部射线可观测性调节其自由度。进一步采用置信度引导的三维小波正则化，以平衡高频细节保留与噪声抑制。本作品基于知识共享署名4.0国际许可协议。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验表明，TR-GS在大多数评估设置中优于代表性基线方法，并在其余情况下保持竞争力。所得体表示可支持下游医学多媒体应用，包括基于XR的可视化和交互式临床渲染。

title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
summary: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. At inference, it operates zero-shot, predicting any concept in its ~40,000-code vocabulary without task-specific training. Our tokenisation scheme retains the clinical granularity of ICD-10, OPCS-4, and SNOMED CT codes, jointly representing absolute and relative timing. We designed an evaluation framework for 30-day COVID-19 hospitalisation and mortality, including subgroup analyses by demographic factors and vaccination status. To assess generalisation to unseen future data and the pandemic's indirect effects, we tested the model on medical events from 2023 (beyond its training period), benchmarking against logistic regression and XGBoost. As detailed in the Project Status section, NHS England has paused access to data for the Foresight-E project, meaning quantitative results are currently unavailable. Instead, we share our strategy for tokenisation, architecture, training, inference, and evaluation as a methodological template and case study in the challenges of building population-scale EHR foundation models.
tldr: Foresight-England is a 243M-parameter generative foundation model for EHRs, trained on 61M patients to predict medical events during COVID-19, but results are unavailable due to data access suspension; the paper serves as a methodological template.
tldr_zh: Foresight-England 是一个用于电子健康记录的 2.43 亿参数生成式基础模型，在 6100 万患者数据上训练以预测 COVID-19 期间的医疗事件，但因数据访问暂停而无法获取结果；本文作为方法模板。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
Foresight-England（Foresight-E）是首个国家级电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，作为研究试点严格用于COVID-19研究。我们评估了其对疫情直接和间接影响进行建模的能力。Foresight-E完全在NHS England安全数据环境中从头训练，是一个拥有2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器。它在约6100万人的去标识化纵向EHR数据上进行了训练和评估，整合了初级/二级保健、死亡登记和COVID-19数据。训练和验证使用了2018年11月至2022年12月间90%的子集（5490万人）；剩余10%（610万人）留作评估。Foresight-E以自回归方式对患者时间线进行建模，根据既往病史预测下一个医疗事件。推理时，它以零样本方式运行，无需特定任务训练即可预测其约4万代码词汇表中的任何概念。我们的分词方案保留了ICD-10、OPCS-4和SNOMED CT编码的临床粒度，并联合表示绝对时间与相对时间。我们为30天COVID-19住院和死亡率设计了一个评估框架，包括按人口统计学因素和疫苗接种状态进行的亚组分析。为评估模型对未见未来数据及疫情间接影响的泛化能力，我们测试了模型在2023年（超出其训练期）的医疗事件上的表现，并与逻辑回归和XGBoost进行了基准比较。如项目状态部分所述，NHS England已暂停对Foresight-E项目的数据访问，这意味着目前无法获取定量结果。因此，我们将分词、架构、训练、推理和评估策略作为方法论模板和案例研究分享，以展示构建人口规模EHR基础模型所面临的挑战。
